meta.name: product-video-creator
meta.description: 多智能体协同的商品视频创作流水线，支持从商品信息到成视频的全流程创作：文案生成、故事策划、脚本创作、分镜设计、图片生成、字幕创作、音效推荐及视频合成；适用于电商商品宣传、品牌推广、社交媒体营销等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从商品信息自动生成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作电商或品牌宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate promotional videos from product info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create e-commerce or brand promo videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你完成商品视频创作全流程：从文案、故事、脚本、分镜、图片、字幕、音效到最终合成MP4视频。
howto.when: 当你提供商品信息（名称、卖点、图片等）和视频需求（时长、风格、目标受众）时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这款智能手表制作一个30秒宣传视频。
say.note: Claude 会启动多智能体流水线，逐步生成视频。

say.text: 为这款护肤品创作一个60秒品牌视频，风格温暖优雅。
say.note: Claude 会根据商品信息和风格要求生成完整视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through the full product video creation pipeline: copywriting, story planning, script writing, storyboard design, image generation, subtitle creation, sound effect recommendation, and final MP4 video synthesis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide product information (name, selling points, images, etc.) and video requirements (duration, style, target audience).

say_en.text: Create a 30-second promotional video for this smartwatch.
say_en.note: Claude will start the multi-agent pipeline and generate the video step by step.

say_en.text: Make a 60-second brand video for this skincare product with a warm and elegant style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a complete video based on product info and style.
